scenes.title: Nightly Reset
scenes.text: Every single night your brain runs a cleanup crew, washing away waste while your body lies still.
scenes.hook: YOUR BRAIN CLEANS ITSELF EVERY NIGHT

scenes.title: Sleep Cycle
scenes.text: Sleep moves in cycles of about ninety minutes, passing through light, deep, and dream filled stages.

scenes.title: Repair Mode
scenes.text: Deep sleep is when your body repairs tissue and your immune system grows stronger for tomorrow.

scenes.title: Dream Time
scenes.text: During REM sleep your brain is almost as active as when awake, but your body cannot move.

scenes.title: Memory Sort
scenes.text: Sleep helps your brain decide what to remember, keeping the useful parts and discarding the rest.

scenes.title: No Sleep
scenes.text: Skip a whole night and your focus, mood, and reaction time all start to fall apart very quickly.

scenes.title: Best Amount
scenes.text: Most adults need around seven to nine hours, and the quality matters just as much as the number.

scenes.title: Your Turn
scenes.text: Sleep is the most powerful reset you own. What is the one thing that always ruins yours?
